item.title: Snowmobile accident kills man near Iron Mine Mountain
item.description: A snowmobile accident was reported to the Wasatch County 911 center around 11:45 a.m. on Friday in the Iron Mine Mountain area east of Woodland. According to the Wasatch County Sheriff’s Office, a preliminary investigation indicates the man driving the snowmobile crashed and became trapped beneath it. The time he was trapped is unknown.
